name: Android-Control
description: Lightweight MCP Server for Android Operating System
long_description:
Android-Control is a lightweight, open-source tool that bridges between AI agents and Android devices. Running as an MCP server, it lets LLM agents perform real-world tasks such as **app navigation, UI interaction and automated QA testing** without relying on traditional computer-vision pipelines or preprogramed scripts.

**KEY FEATURES**
- **Native Android Integration**: Interact with UI elements via ADB and the Android Accessibility API.
- **Bring Your Own LLM/VLM**: Works with any language model.
- **Rich Toolset for Mobile Automation**: Pre-built tools for gestures, keystrokes, capture, device state, etc.
- **Real-Time Interaction**: Typical latency between actions ranges 2-4s.

**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS**
- Python 3.13
- Android Debug Bridge (ADB)
Ensure ADB is installed and your device is connected/authorized.
- UV Package Manager
This MCP server requires UV, a fast Python package manager.
Installation:
`curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh`
For detailed installation instructions, [see the UV documentation](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv)

**WINDOWS NOTE**
Use Python 3.13 for `uvx` on Windows. Python 3.14 currently fails to resolve a transitive `pywin32` dependency from the MCP stack.

tools.name: ListDevices
tools.description: List available ADB devices and their connection state.

tools.name: ConnectDevice
tools.description: Connect to an ADB device by serial number.

tools.name: Device
tools.description: Manage ADB devices (list, connect, or disconnect).

tools.name: GetDeviceInfo
tools.description: Get detailed device information (model, Android version, resolution, etc.).

tools.name: LaunchApp
tools.description: Launch a specific app by package name.

tools.name: StopApp
tools.description: Stop/force-stop a specific app.

tools.name: GetCurrentApp
tools.description: Get the currently running app package and activity.

tools.name: ListApps
tools.description: List all installed apps (limited to first 50).

tools.name: WaitForActivity
tools.description: Wait for a specific activity to be in foreground.

tools.name: Click
tools.description: Click on a specific coordinate (x, y).

tools.name: LongClick
tools.description: Long click on a specific coordinate (x, y).

tools.name: Swipe
tools.description: Swipe from one coordinate (x1, y1) to another (x2, y2).

tools.name: Type
tools.description: Type text on a specific coordinate (x, y). Can clear existing text if clear=True.

tools.name: Drag
tools.description: Drag from location (x1, y1) and drop on another location (x2, y2).

tools.name: Press
tools.description: Press on specific button on the device (Back, Home, etc).

tools.name: PressKey
tools.description: Press a physical key (home, back, volume_up, volume_down, etc.).

tools.name: ClickBySelector
tools.description: Click on an element by selector (text, resourceId, className, description). More reliable than coordinate clicks.

tools.name: MultiTap
tools.description: Tap multiple times rapidly at a location.

tools.name: MultiClick
tools.description: Click on multiple coordinates or elements in a single operation. Supports both coordinate-based (x, y) and selector-based (text, resourceId, className, description) actions. Continues execution even if individual actions fail.

tools.name: MultiFillText
tools.description: Fill text in multiple form fields in a single operation. Each field is cleared before typing. Supports both coordinate-based (x, y) and selector-based (text, resourceId, className, description) actions. Continues execution even if individual actions fail.

tools.name: Scroll
tools.description: Scroll in a specific direction (up, down, left, right).

tools.name: ScrollToElement
tools.description: Scroll until an element is found.

tools.name: SwipeElement
tools.description: Swipe on a specific element.

tools.name: PullToRefresh
tools.description: Perform a pull-to-refresh gesture by scrolling to top and pulling down significantly to trigger refresh.

tools.name: Snapshot
tools.description: Get the state of the device. Optionally includes visual screenshot when use_vision=True. Returns tree state string and screenshot if requested.

tools.name: Notification
tools.description: Access the notifications seen on the device.

tools.name: Wait
tools.description: Wait for a specific amount of time (seconds).

tools.name: WaitForElement
tools.description: Wait for an element to appear on screen using selectors.

tools.name: VerifyText
tools.description: Verify if text exists on screen.

tools.name: GetElementInfo
tools.description: Get detailed information about an element by selector.

tools.name: GetElementParent
tools.description: Get parent of an element by selector.

tools.name: TakeScreenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot and save to device.

tools.name: GetClipboard
tools.description: Get text from clipboard.

tools.name: SetClipboard
tools.description: Set text to clipboard.

tools.name: ExecuteShell
tools.description: Execute a shell command on device.

tools.name: GetLogs
tools.description: Get Android logcat logs.

tools.name: ClearLogs
tools.description: Clear logcat buffer.

tools.name: ToggleWiFi
tools.description: Turn WiFi on or off.

tools.name: SetOrientation
tools.description: Set screen orientation (portrait, landscape, auto).

tools.name: GetBatteryInfo
tools.description: Get battery information.

tools.name: GetNetworkInfo
tools.description: Get network connection information.

tools.name: GetAPILogs
tools.description: Get logs related to API calls from the app. Filters logcat for HTTP requests, network operations, and API calls.

tools.name: StartAPILogger
tools.description: Start logging API requests/responses by clearing logs and preparing for capture.

tools.name: StopAPILogger
tools.description: Stop logging API requests/responses and return captured data with formatted output.

tools.name: GetAPIResponse
tools.description: Extract response data from API logs. Use after StopAPILogger to get specific response details.

tools.name: SetProxy
tools.description: Set HTTP/HTTPS proxy for device to intercept API traffic (requires proxy server like Charles/Fiddler).

tools.name: ClearProxy
tools.description: Clear HTTP/HTTPS proxy settings from device.
